source_claim: AlphaEvolve's evolutionary database is active population state, so archive resume should distinguish durable current-state snapshots from ordered migration-event replay
claim_boundary: This boundary records that LibreEvolve validates archive_events.jsonl, checks non-decreasing migration sequences, restores archive cursor state and current cell/elite archive contents from manifest snapshots joined with accepted history, and emits an archive-event replay audit that compares final migration placements against archive contents. It does not claim ordered archive-event restore-engine support, skip event reconstruction, replacement-history replay, descriptor-policy mismatch restore failures, or controller pending-work restore.
